series.name: How They Make Money From You
series.format: One everyday product or 'free' service, the hidden money machine behind it, and the exact moment you pay. Hook (the friendly-looking thing) → follow one dollar → the trap reveal → the number they hope you never do → Penny's smug last line.
series.hookFormula: Why does [company] actually WANT you to [thing that sounds good for you]?
series.example: Why does your credit card want you to pay the minimum?

series.name: Money Myths
series.format: A belief most people hold, busted with one chart or one receipt. Hook (state the myth like it's true) → Penny's 'nope' → what really happens, step by step → the surprising real rule → loop back to the myth.
series.example: Everyone thinks banks lend out your savings. They don't even need them.

series.name: The Math Of…
series.format: One number worked out on screen: a calculator, a ticking counter and a precise chart. Hook (the end result as a shock) → the inputs → the math, animated → the twist that changes the number → one rule of thumb to remember.
series.hookFormula: This [small number] turns into [big number]. Here's the math.
series.example: Seven percent a year doubles your money in about ten years. Here's the rule of 72.

series.name: Rich People Tricks, Explained
series.format: A legal, well-known move wealthy people or big companies use, explained plainly and neutrally (what it is, why it works, who it works for), never as a how-to. Penny wears her monocle. Hook (the move sounds impossible) → how it works in three steps → the catch → why most people never see it.
series.hookFormula: How do [rich people / billionaires / airlines] [do impossible-sounding thing]?
series.example: How does an airline earn billions selling miles it gives away for free?
